objects.RawValueFCO: {raw: exact string as observed, units, uncertainty?}; content_id over the exact raw string, so '1.0' and '1.00' are different identities
objects.EquivalenceRuleFCO: {rule_id, version, quantity, units, mode: tolerance|bin, tolerance{abs,rel,k_sigma} | bin{origin,width}, uncertainty_method, boundary}; rule_hash = content_id(rule)
objects.EquivalenceClassFCO: {class_id = content_id(rule_hash, bin_index), rule_hash}: shared by all members
objects.ClassificationFCO: {raw_id, class_id, rule_hash, predecessor_ref}: never edited; reclassification is a successor
